## How you know

<!-- Your own pattern, a book and page, trade practice. -->

- [ ] `python skills/pattern-making/scripts/pattern.py check` prints no `!!` line
- [ ] Data only: no photo, scan, tracing or PDF, and no generated file (`INDEX.md`, `COVERAGE.md`, `CREDITS.md`, `.svg`, analysis `.md`)
- [ ] `provenance` (data) or `Confidence` and `Status` (knowledge base) say where it comes from and how it was taken
- [ ] I may share this: my own work, public domain, or values cited from a named source
- [ ] A pattern: `python skills/pattern-making/scripts/pattern.py analyze <id>` prints no `!!` line
- [ ] Code changes only: `python skills/pattern-making/scripts/pattern.py test` passes
